workarounds.symptom: CI fails with vLLM for GRPO structured outputs: AssertionError: Parameter model.layers.1.self_attn.k_proj.bias has not changed.
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Require top_k for GRPO structured outputs with the vLLM importance sampling correction. Target files: trl/trainer/grpo_config.py, trl/trainer/grpo_trainer.py, tests/test_grpo_trainer.py. This PR makes GRPO with vLLM structured outputs and the importance sampling correction require `top_k > 0`, so that the trainer normalizes its log-probs over the tokens the grammar allows. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8145)

workarounds.symptom: CI fails with vLLM for PEFT with a tied lm_head: ValueError: 'lm_head.weight' was skipped because it is tied to 'model.embed_tokens.weight'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Raise when PEFT trains separate copies of tied embeddings with vLLM. Target files: trl/generation/vllm_generation.py, tests/test_grpo_trainer.py, tests/test_rloo_trainer.py. This PR makes vLLM generation fail fast when a PEFT model trains separate copies of tied word embeddings, and makes the vLLM PEFT tests of GRPO and RLOO train a single tied copy. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8144)

workarounds.symptom: GRPO crashes on Qwen2-VL / Qwen2.5-VL with transformers < 5.3.0 when a completion ends with `<|vision_start|>`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Widen the tiny Qwen2.5-VL text model so Flash Attention accepts its heads. Target files: scripts/generate_tiny_models/for_conditional_generation/qwen2_5_vl_for_conditional_generation.py, tests/experimental/test_async_grpo_trainer.py. Part of #6857. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8148)

workarounds.symptom: Tiny GLM-5.3-Flash model fails its forward pass: AssertionError: Bs must be 3D (num_experts, N//block_n, K//block_k), got ndim=2
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Drop the FP8 quantization from the tiny GLM-5.3-Flash script. Target files: scripts/generate_tiny_models/for_conditional_generation/glm5_next_for_conditional_generation.py. This PR drops the FP8 quantization from the tiny GLM-5.3-Flash generation script, so that the model is saved in bf16 and its forward pass runs. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8119)

workarounds.symptom: GRPO with vLLM: `repetition_penalty` drives the importance sampling ratio to 0 and stalls training
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Raise when GRPO combines `repetition_penalty` with the vLLM importance sampling correction. Target files: trl/trainer/grpo_config.py, tests/test_grpo_trainer.py. vLLM applies `repetition_penalty` to the log-probs it returns, and the trainer recomputes them without it, so the importance sampling correction (on by default) drives the ratio to ~1e-28 and the gradient to 0 with no error. `GRPOConfig` now raises for this combination, like AsyncGRPO does for `top_p` without `top_k`, and points to `vllm_importance_sampling_correcti... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/7915)

workarounds.symptom: SFT: `padding_free=True` is refused with any `max_length`, although truncation now runs in dataset preparation
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Stop refusing `padding_free=True` with `max_length` in SFT. Target files: trl/trainer/sft_trainer.py, tests/invariant/test_invariant.py, tests/test_sft_trainer.py. SFT raised when `padding_free=True` met any `max_length` (including the default 1024) without packing. The guard dates from when truncation lived in the collator, which padding-free bypassed. Truncation now runs in dataset preparation for padding-free too, so the guard only blocked a valid config. It's removed. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8077)

workarounds.symptom: MoE aux loss: `AttributeError: ... has no attribute 'num_experts'` on Granite MoE, granite-4.0-h and PhiMoE
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix the MoE aux loss on configs without `num_experts` (Granite MoE, granite-4.0-h, PhiMoE). Target files: trl/experimental/async_distillation/async_distillation_trainer.py, trl/trainer/utils.py, tests/test_utils.py. The fused LM head and AsyncDistillation read the expert count from `config.num_experts`, which Granite MoE, granite-4.0-h and PhiMoE configs do not define (only `num_local_experts`). Both now read the count off the router logits, which also drops the gpt-oss special case from #5754. Hybrid checkpoints without exp... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/7919)

workarounds.symptom: GRPO/RLOO + vLLM: a PEFT adapter with `modules_to_save` crashes at the first weight sync
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip the other adapters' `modules_to_save` copies in the vLLM weight sync. Target files: trl/experimental/async_distillation/async_distillation_trainer.py, trl/experimental/async_grpo/async_grpo_trainer.py, trl/experimental/online_dpo/online_dpo_trainer.py. With a pretrained adapter, GRPO (when `beta != 0`) and RLOO add a "ref" copy of the adapter for the reference model. When the adapter has `modules_to_save`, the vLLM weight sync stripped only the `modules_to_save.default.` prefix, so it also sent the frozen `lm_head.modul... (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/trl/pull/8079)
